en.title: 8 Beloved Games Departing Xbox Game Pass This October
en.summary: Get ready to bid farewell to some fan favorites on Xbox Game Pass. Eight titles are set to leave the service on October 31st, offering a final chance for subscribers to dive in.
en.body:
It's that time of the month again, and Xbox is preparing to refresh its Game Pass library. As is customary, a selection of games will be departing the service, with eight titles scheduled to leave on October 31st. This includes a mix of beloved LucasArts classics, a cooperative gem, and a massive LEGO adventure.

Fans of classic point-and-click adventures will want to take note. The remastered editions of **Full Throttle** and **Day of the Tentacle** are among the games making their exit. These beloved titles from the 90s have been given a fresh coat of paint with high-resolution artwork and remastered audio, offering a fantastic way to experience these narrative-driven experiences.

Beyond the point-and-click classics, several other genres are represented in this wave of departures. The action-packed co-op shooter **Deep Rock Galactic**, known for its addictive mining and bug-blasting gameplay, will no longer be available on Game Pass. Strategy fans will also need to make their move on the tactical RPG **Wartales**. For those seeking a unique blend of ship-to-ship combat and fast-paced action, the PvPvE multiplayer shooter **Wildgate** is also leaving.

The departures also include **Dead Static Drive**, a title often described as 'Grand Theft Cthulhu' for its unique blend of open-world exploration and cosmic horror. Additionally, **Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris**, a top-notch co-op experience that expands the Tomb Raider universe with more players, will be removed. Finally, the expansive **Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga**, which masterfully retells all nine mainline films with signature LEGO charm, is also on its way out. This massive title offers hundreds of hours of content, making its departure a significant loss for many.

## A Final Chance for Subscribers

For those who haven't yet experienced these titles or wish to revisit them, the clock is ticking. All eight games will be unavailable as part of the Game Pass subscription after October 31st. However, Xbox offers subscribers a way to hold onto these games: you can purchase them at a discount of up to 20% before they leave the service. This provides a valuable opportunity to own these games permanently and continue playing them long after they've been removed from the Game Pass library.

## What This Means for the Game Pass Library

The regular rotation of titles on Xbox Game Pass is a key aspect of the service's value proposition, ensuring a fresh and diverse library for subscribers. While the departures are always a point of discussion for the community, they also pave the way for new additions. The loss of these eight games, particularly the Double Fine remasters and the highly popular **Deep Rock Galactic**, will undoubtedly be felt by many players who have come to rely on Game Pass for their gaming needs.

## What's Next

With October drawing to a close, players should keep an eye on official Xbox channels for announcements regarding new Game Pass additions for November. Until then, there are just over two weeks left to experience these eight titles before they leave the service.

content_raw: It's that time of month when Xbox updates the Game Pass library, and, as usual, a few more games are leaving the subscription service in a few weeks. On October 31, you can say goodbye to 8 more games, including a few LucasArts classics, a diggy-diggy blast of co-op fun, and one of the biggest Lego Star Wars games of all time. With Double Fine no longer part of the Xbox Game Studios family, it looks like two of the studio's best remasters will be leaving soon. The remastered editions of Full Throttle and Day of the Tentacle are on their way out, so if you haven't checked out these classic '90s point-and-click adventures, now is a great time to do so. Each one features high-resolution artwork and remastered audio. You'll also want to grab the action-packed co-op shooter Deep Rock Galactic , the strategic RPG Wartales , and the PvPvE multiplayer shooter Wildgate , which fuses ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced action. Dead Static Drive is a hidden gem best described as Grand Theft Cthulhu, while Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris is a top-notch co-op game that lets even more players join the intrepid archaeologist on her expeditions. Finally, Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga is a massive game that covers all nine movies in the classic sci-fi series, and like a bucket of Lego, it can keep you entertained for hours. At the start of the month , nine games left Xbox Game Pass, with the critically acclaimed Expedition 33: Clair Obscur as the biggest departure. Other notable exits included The Casting of Frank Stone, A Plague Tale: Requiem, Donut County, and Evil West.
